name: Shipping Update
description: Notify customers their order has shipped with tracking.
html_content:
Your order is on its way

Hi {first_name},

Good news — your order {order_number} just shipped and is on its way to you.

Delivery details

  • Carrier: {carrier}
  • Tracking #: {tracking_number}
  • Estimated delivery: {estimated_delivery}

Track your package

Thanks for shopping with {company_name}.
